mentions.name: Dreamlist
mentions.description: A private wish list and registry site that lets users group lists of friends and family into one page to share with grandparents or social media, and run family holiday giving, gift drives, toy drives, and disaster recovery without ads or spam. It keeps users' names and registries off search engines and offers additional privacy features.
mentions.problem: Typical wish list and registry sites publish your name and registry to search engines and come with ads and spam; this site stays private and ad-free.
mentions.source_excerpt: Preparing https://www.dreamlist.com for the holidays. It's a private wish list and registry site that enables you to also group lists of friends and family into one page to share with grandparents or social media.
